answer: Harbor-inlet ceremony bond. Each identity books one harbor inlet berth, locks 70. Each epoch a beacon draws one minute; each identity files a velvet-sealed tide reading from its inlet. No operator can be at two inlets at once, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 berths. Filings cost 40+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 2,537,500, lock 70,000, against a 40,000 pool. A velvet seal binds key to inlet gauge, so rented stand-ins burn bonds. Honest agents pay 40 once.
